text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The super ultra mascot, lovely
Maaachan. ♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? I was working on
that over
my break. It's a song to
remember me by!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've gotten really good at singing it. Now
my
lovely voice will get stuck in
everyone's head!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan sings on passionately. It
sounds
like she had a great break!
